name: IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores
description:
The IdealData connector brings an online store's live operating picture directly to Claude. It surfaces the store's active signals along with the data behind them: orders, products and per-warehouse inventory, customers and their lifetime value, active and abandoned carts, traffic sources, search performance, and headline business figures for any date range. Every tool is read-only, so nothing in a store is created, changed, or deleted.

IdealData monitors a connected store around the clock and raises a signal when something needs a person. Six signal types are live: a repeat buyer who passed their expected reorder date without ordering, a customer whose behavior indicates they are in a buying window now, a product heading for a stockout with supplier lead time and a decide-by date attached, a pricing error such as a product listed at zero or far outside its margin target, a high-value cart left behind, and a cart abandoned by a known high-value customer. Each signal arrives with what triggered it, the value at stake, and a recommended next step.

The connector reads across every system a merchant has connected: their store platform (Adobe Commerce, Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce), inventory and fulfillment, customer records, call activity, and site and search performance. A sales rep preparing for a call can see an account's full purchase history alongside what they have browsed and who they have spoken to since. Weekly planning gets the reorders worth chasing and the products that need a purchase order now. Month-end revenue traces back to the traffic and search queries that produced it. None of it requires opening four dashboards, exporting reports, and stitching the results together in a spreadsheet.

Requires an IdealData account with at least one connected store. A 15-day free trial is available with no credit card.

_published_faq.name: How do I add IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my.idealdata.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores lists 15 MCP tools, including get_alert, get_business_kpi, get_customer, get_customer_journey, get_order, get_product, get_seo_summary, get_traffic_sources, list_alert_types, list_brands, search_alerts, and search_carts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: IdealData.io: Real-time signals for eCommerce Stores requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
